profile.name: Kris
profile.headline: Chrome extensions that quietly remove friction from your workday.
profile.bio: I’m a practical problem solver at heart. When I hit a repetitive task, a clunky workflow, or a gap between tools, I don’t just complain—I build a better way. My extensions are small, opinionated products born from real browser moments: drafting posts, inspecting APIs, automating workflows, locking down privacy, and moving faster. I like thinking around corners, combining simple ideas in unexpected ways, and shipping tools that feel obvious only after you’ve used them.

extensions.name: SocialPostForge
extensions.tagline: Forge scroll-stopping social posts in seconds.
extensions.shortDescription: Turn an image or rough notes into polished, ready-to-copy social media posts across multiple styles.
extensions.painpoint: Another blank post. Another hour lost trying to sound interesting.
useCases: Founders promoting product updates without hiring a copywriter
Marketers turning screenshots into launch threads
Creators staying consistent across Twitter, LinkedIn, and Instagram
keyFeatures: Image or text input
Multiple post styles
AIDA, PAS, and Cialdini prompt library
Privacy-first local storage

extensions.name: ExecPilot
extensions.tagline: Your executive co-pilot inside the browser.
extensions.shortDescription: Draft decisive emails, sharpen LinkedIn outreach, and move faster on high-stakes tasks.
extensions.painpoint: You know what you mean. You just can’t get it to sound right.
useCases: Founders writing investor updates and cold outreach
Leaders handling sensitive team conversations
Operators replying fast without sounding rushed
keyFeatures: Executive tone drafts
LinkedIn and email templates
Quick decision frameworks

extensions.name: LoomPath
extensions.tagline: Turn repetitive browser work into a dependable system.
extensions.shortDescription: Record, automate, and orchestrate browser workflows locally—from clicks and scraping to data transformation and delivery.
extensions.painpoint: You’re doing the same clicks, copying the same fields, every single day.
useCases: Ops teams extracting and delivering data between web apps
Recruiters scraping candidate lists into spreadsheets
Founders automating onboarding and reporting workflows
keyFeatures: Visual action recording and selection
If/Then, Switch logic, JSON parsing
Local-first execution with encrypted secrets
Webhooks, API calls, and scheduled runs

extensions.name: ContractGuardian
extensions.tagline: Local-first API intelligence in Chrome DevTools.
extensions.shortDescription: Capture network traffic, detect API contract drift, and turn mysterious requests into usable data—without injecting code.
extensions.painpoint: The data is right there in the network tab, but getting it out feels like archaeology.
useCases: Developers discovering undocumented endpoints behind any page
Engineers monitoring APIs for unexpected schema changes
Builders exporting live request data to CSV, JS, JSON, or Loompath
keyFeatures: HTTP request capture and baseline comparison
Schema drift detection
API Finder with local Ollama support
Export recipes to CSV, JS, JSON, or Loompath

extensions.name: JourneyLens
extensions.tagline: See the journey. Spot the risk.
extensions.shortDescription: Record real browser walkthroughs and turn them into reproducible local QA, resilient tests, evidence-rich reports, and training packages.
extensions.fullDescription: JourneyLens captures the intent, timing, selectors, screenshots, diagnostics, and assertions behind a real browser process, then turns the journey into maintainable local QA, Loompath workflows, Playwright tests, reports, and internal training artifacts.
extensions.painpoint: The process worked yesterday. Today nobody knows which step changed—or where the risk appeared.
useCases: QA teams recording checkout, onboarding, and approval journeys
Operations teams turning real processes into repeatable evidence
Product teams exporting maintainable Playwright and Loompath tests
keyFeatures: Semantic journey recording with resilient selector fallbacks
Assertions, diagnostics, timing, screenshots, and accessibility checks
Local replay with Playwright, Loompath, and report exports
Local-first storage with redacted training packages

extensions.name: AirLock
extensions.tagline: Stop secrets before they leave your browser.
extensions.shortDescription: Check text before you submit it to catch API keys, credentials, PII, and internal terms—then redact, mask, or block them.
extensions.painpoint: One paste into ChatGPT and your API key is part of the training data.
useCases: Engineers pasting logs and code into AI tools safely
Support teams sanitizing tickets before sending
Anyone blocking PII, tokens, and internal terms from leaving the browser
keyFeatures: Local detection of secrets and PII
Redact, pseudonymize, mask, or block
Optional on-device Ollama classification
Safe form application of sanitized values

extensions.name: Ritual
extensions.tagline: Turn browser work into a ritual your team can repeat.
extensions.shortDescription: Record a browser workflow and turn it into a polished, reusable SOP with captured screenshots, editable steps, and PDF export.
extensions.fullDescription: Ritual captures the meaningful clicks and form changes in a browser workflow, then formats them into a clear, print-ready standard operating procedure your team can follow and reuse.
extensions.painpoint: You know the process. Your team is still learning it from a messy screen recording.
useCases: Operations teams documenting repeatable browser processes
Founders turning onboarding flows into clear playbooks
Support and enablement teams creating visual SOPs without manual screenshots
keyFeatures: Browser interaction recording with captured screenshots
Editable, print-ready SOPs and PDF export
Saved workflow library and resume capture
Optional AI, dictation, and branded exports with Ritual Pro

extensions.name: ClipPilot
extensions.shortDescription: Recognize and transform structured data, code, logs, security content, and more directly from Chrome's side panel.
extensions.fullDescription: ClipPilot turns copied JSON, SQL, JWTs, cURL, logs, infrastructure configuration, and 20+ other formats into an intelligent local-first workspace with contextual actions, safe transformations, and optional AI.
extensions.painpoint: You copied the answer. Now you are wasting time finding another tool to understand or transform it.
useCases: Developers formatting JSON, SQL, cURL, JWTs, and configuration without changing tools
Security-conscious teams detecting and redacting sensitive clipboard content locally
Operators using Ollama or OpenRouter for contextual transformations on demand
keyFeatures: Local detection for 25+ clipboard content types
Contextual formatting, conversion, validation, and extraction actions
Sensitive-data protection with no automatic uploads
Ollama-first AI with optional OpenRouter support

extensions.name: DevRecall
extensions.tagline: Your technical memory, beside the browser.
extensions.shortDescription: Search syntax by intent, save reusable snippets, understand errors, and learn recurring concepts without leaving the current tab.
extensions.fullDescription: DevRecall turns vague technical memory into copy-ready answers. It combines curated references, personal snippets, error intelligence, guarded AI, code packs, an extraction workbench, and focused recall in a local-first Chrome side panel.
extensions.painpoint: You remember the idea, but lose the next ten minutes searching for the exact syntax again.
useCases: Developers recalling JavaScript, Python, Git, Regex, API, and DOM patterns by intent
Data professionals finding Snowflake, SQL, Excel, Access, and LAMBDA solutions
Automation engineers validating selectors, diagnosing errors, and retaining extraction recipes
keyFeatures: Intent-ranked curated references and personal snippet library
Deterministic error fixes with guarded AI fallback
CSS and XPath extraction workbench with local previews
Portable code packs, focused learning, and optional Ollama or cloud AI
